text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so, so happy~! To think I get to go 
stargazing with Ayabe-san♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren would go to the top of a mountain 
or the bottom of the sea if it's to take 
cute pictures!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's a little chilly, but Curren is 
totally fine! Mastering cuteness is a lot 
like mountain climbing!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, that's so cold~! Curren was 
looking forward to it so much!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...That brightly shining star over there 
is the Andromeda Galaxy. Can you see how 
it looks faintly elliptical?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
My name comes from a beautiful princess in 
Greek mythology. She was offered as a 
sacrifice, but saved by a hero.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You're awfully quiet. Could you stop 
staring at my face?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Gh!? Why are you suddenly pointing a 
camera at me...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because the starry sky reflected in 
Ayabe-san's eyes was just so cute.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are you an idiot?! Come on, hand over 
your phone so I can delete it!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You can't do that! I won't show it to 
anyone, so please forgive me♪
